levels.surface: علي بن أحمد بن محمد بن عمران الدقاق
محمد ابن أبي عبد الله الكوفي

notes: Abu Abdullah is written inside the chain after «عن», so he is a narrator.

«أمير المؤمنين» speaks and acts inside the narrated scene (Dhiʿlib's question); whether he is a further link or only in the scene is not settled by the rules (narrated encounter where the Imam speaks).
